title: Shoulder-a-Coffin Kuro
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Kuro, a girl often mistaken for a boy or a vampire, travels the land dressed in black with a coffin on her back and a sarcastic bat companion, Sen. In gentle four-panel episodes she meets good, wicked and odd people, while hints accumulate about a curse and what she is searching for (Yen Press blurb via AniList; MangaUpdates).
life_message: Kindness to strangers met along the road and a chosen family make a short or burdened life meaningful.
